boards.title: Your First Weekend at University of Michigan-Dearborn, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A source-backed, under-21-safe sequence that begins on campus and branches into Dearborn cultural destinations; confirm venue schedules before leaving.

cards.title: Start by learning the lay of campus
cards.subtitle: Main Campus Tour · University of Michigan-Dearborn
cards.notes: Reserve a listed main-campus tour when one fits your arrival weekend, then use the visit map to orient yourself to the central academic buildings.
cards.short_summary: Begin with a scheduled introduction to the main campus.
cards.evidence_claim: UM-Dearborn’s events calendar lists recurring Main Campus Tour sessions, and the university provides visitor maps and directions.
cards.source_title: Maps and Directions | University of Michigan-Dearborn
cards.access_notes: Tours are schedule-dependent; check the university events calendar before planning.

cards.title: Make the Renick University Center your checkpoint
cards.subtitle: Campus hub for services, gathering, and dining
cards.notes: Stop at the information desk for current campus-resource guidance, then use the building as a practical meeting point while you explore nearby spaces.
cards.short_summary: A central campus stop for information and everyday services.
cards.evidence_claim: University Unions & Events identifies the James C. Renick University Center as a primary location for communal, conference, dining, and information services.
cards.source_title: University Unions & Events | University of Michigan-Dearborn
cards.access_notes: The university posts building and service hours; hours can change by term.

cards.title: Find the Mardigian Library before you need it
cards.subtitle: Mardigian Library · Main Campus
cards.notes: Locate the library on the campus map and take a short look around its exterior and entrances so a future study or research visit feels familiar.
cards.short_summary: Identify a key academic landmark during your campus walk.
cards.evidence_claim: UM-Dearborn’s campus map lists the Mardigian Library, and the Armenian Research Center states that it is on the library’s fourth floor.
cards.source_title: Armenian Research Center | University of Michigan-Dearborn
cards.access_notes: Consult library access information before planning interior use.

cards.title: Pause at Chancellor’s Pond
cards.subtitle: Outdoor campus landmark
cards.notes: Take a quiet outdoor break by the pond, using the seating and fountain area as a natural reset between the University Center and nearby buildings.
cards.short_summary: A brief outdoor pause along a main-campus walk.
cards.evidence_claim: UM-Dearborn’s admissions blog identifies Chancellor’s Pond as a campus location with a spring fountain, chairs, and stone benches.
cards.source_title: Top 10 study spaces on campus | University of Michigan-Dearborn
cards.access_notes: Outdoor conditions and seasonal fountain operation vary.

cards.title: Walk the Environmental Study Area trails
cards.subtitle: Environmental Interpretive Center · Main Campus
cards.notes: Choose a daylight trail walk from the Environmental Interpretive Center, staying on the marked two-mile system and allowing time to observe the habitats.
cards.short_summary: Spend part of the afternoon on the university’s nature trails.
cards.evidence_claim: The Environmental Interpretive Center describes a 120-acre preserve with a two-mile trail system and states that trails are accessible daily from sunrise to sunset.
cards.source_title: Environmental Interpretive Center | University of Michigan-Dearborn
cards.access_notes: Trails are accessible seven days a week from sunrise to sunset; use daylight and follow posted conditions.

cards.title: Use the Wellness Center for a campus activity break
cards.subtitle: Inside the Fieldhouse · UM-Dearborn
cards.notes: If you are a current student, bring your Mcard and use the cardio, weights, courts, or other listed fitness facilities as your active afternoon stop.
cards.short_summary: A student-access fitness option in the Fieldhouse.
cards.evidence_claim: UM-Dearborn states that current students have free access to the Wellness Center, located inside the Fieldhouse.
cards.source_title: Health and Wellness | University of Michigan-Dearborn
cards.access_notes: Open to current students, faculty, and staff; bring applicable university identification and verify facility hours.

cards.title: Spend an afternoon with Arab American history and art
cards.subtitle: 13624 Michigan Avenue · Dearborn
cards.notes: Plan a museum visit around its posted Wednesday-through-Sunday schedule, leaving time to view exhibitions that document Arab American experiences and contributions.
cards.short_summary: A Dearborn museum visit centered on Arab American culture and history.
cards.evidence_claim: The Arab American National Museum presents exhibitions, art, film screenings, performances, and documentation of Arab American history and experiences.
cards.access_notes: Posted regular hours are Wednesday–Sunday; general admission is listed at $10, with specified discounts and free categories.

cards.entity_name: Henry Ford Museum of American Innovation
cards.title: Choose a museum-focused Dearborn outing
cards.subtitle: The Henry Ford · Dearborn
cards.notes: Set aside a separate block for the museum and check current ticket availability before traveling; use the official plan-your-visit page for the day’s details.
cards.short_summary: A ticketed history-and-innovation museum option near campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Henry Ford’s official tickets page lists admission pricing for Henry Ford Museum of American Innovation.
cards.access_notes: Ticket prices and operating hours are posted by The Henry Ford; check the official page before visiting.

cards.title: Save Greenfield Village for a daylight visit
cards.subtitle: The Henry Ford · Dearborn
cards.notes: If the village is operating during your weekend, plan it as a standalone daytime outing and review the official schedule and ticket options in advance.
cards.short_summary: A separate ticketed historic-village visit in Dearborn.
cards.evidence_claim: The Henry Ford’s official tickets page lists Greenfield Village admission pricing and visitor planning information.
cards.access_notes: Seasonal operations and ticket availability vary; verify the official schedule before planning the visit.

cards.title: End with a scheduled observatory session
cards.subtitle: Science Learning and Research Center · Main Campus
cards.notes: On a listed Friday, arrive prepared for outdoor observing and check the status update an hour beforehand, since weather can cancel the session.
cards.short_summary: A free, family-friendly Friday night astronomy program.
cards.evidence_claim: UM-Dearborn states that Public Nights at the Observatory run May–October 2026, are free and open to the public, and use Observatory telescopes.
cards.source_title: Public Nights at the Observatory | University of Michigan-Dearborn
cards.access_notes: Scheduled Friday sessions run at listed evening times; the September 11, 2026 session is 8:30–10:30 p.m. Weather may cancel observing.
